note: Corps of Engineers campground on a peninsula of the Middle Fork Kentucky River just below Buckhorn Lake dam, near the town of Buckhorn. The east-row sites sit on a low gravel bank at the river; the west row backs onto woods. Walk-in tent and boat-in sites, playground, basketball, swim area and boat ramp; Buckhorn Lake State Resort Park and the Buckhorn Log Church are close by. --Claude
